title: Every tick
hints: `time.NewTicker(interval)` returns a `*time.Ticker` whose channel `t.C` receives once per interval, forever, until you call `t.Stop()`. You want to wait on that channel **and** on `stop` at the same time.
Guard `interval <= 0` first. Then `t := time.NewTicker(interval)`, `defer t.Stop()`, and a `for` loop around a `select` with `case <-stop:` and `case <-t.C:`.
In the tick case: `n++` then `f(n)`. In the stop case: `return n`. Use `return`, not `break`: a plain `break` inside `select` only leaves the `select`, and the loop keeps going.
